title: Great gift to give your cat
text: So, my cats went completely crazy over the box when I put it on my bed. I only bought the box for a single cat to try it. They absolutely love the toys. They did not like the treat though. I think the toys were definitely worth it, especially seeing how excited my cats were. They were so actively playing with the toys that all 3 of them are fast asleep now.
label: positive
